svg.aria-label: A vertical line of sixteen labelled bands, from never made to two methods that disagree, with each chapter number beside the bands it names; chapters 7 and 8 span five and seven bands; four further kinds named in chapter 8 sit below, unreconciled.
svg.text: THE SIXTEEN BANDS, IN THE ORDER THE CHAPTERS FOUND THEM
HOME CHAPTER
never made
commissioned, answered unfavourably, built anyway
made and enclosed
made, given away freely, and still lost
made, enclosed, and made mandatory
made, reachable, not supporting the claim
made openly; the metric standardised without it
made once; the second visit never commissioned
made everywhere at the coarsest resolution
made about a model, not a building
measured on the coupon, asserted for the building
made, licensed open, and still undelivered
made, readable, one query away, not quoted
measured on the artefact, never the population
made only in the future tense
two methods disagree; the cheaper standardised
3 at its far edge
FIVE BANDS
SEVEN BANDS
NAMED IN CHAPTER 8'S CLOSING LANE · NOT YET RECONCILED INTO THE SIXTEEN
a
made, mandated, aggregated; the aggregate withheld
b
made blind by 21 teams; the spread not reported
c
made at scale, openly licensed, about another question
d
measured for the client, aggregated for the public
FOUR MORE
